page.overview:
Who is Micro Mob?

Micro Mobs are brick built Minecraft minifigures. So far, the only Micro Mobs are Steve, the default character of Minecraft, a pig, a Creeper, a Villager, a Zombie Pigman, a Ghast, a Zombie, an Enderman, and the Ender Dragon.
